narrationTexts: All 3 failures are in `order totals`, confirming the bug in `orderTotal`, which computes tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Fixing now.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.

Nothing left to do.
